description: This file defines an interface 'IObjectPoolMonitor' within the Orleans.Providers.Streams.Common namespace, used for monitoring object pool metrics such as allocation, release, and pool status reporting.

classes.name: IObjectPoolMonitor
classes.description: Interface for monitoring object pool-related metrics, including tracking allocations, releases, and reporting pool status.

methods.name: TrackObjectAllocated
methods.description: Method called whenever an object is allocated from the pool.

methods.name: TrackObjectReleased
methods.description: Method called whenever an object is released back into the pool.

methods.name: Report
methods.description: Method to report the current status of the object pool, including total, available, and claimed objects.
